manualSteps.action: Click on Reports and select Legacy Reports.
manualSteps.expected: Legacy Reports list view opens and the available reports are displayed.

manualSteps.action: Change the page size in Legacy Reports list. Example: 25.
manualSteps.expected: Selected page size is applied to the Legacy Reports list.

manualSteps.action: Click Actions for any report and select Duplicate.
manualSteps.expected: Duplicate screen or popup loads successfully.

manualSteps.action: Select System folder and click Save.
manualSteps.expected: Selected report is duplicated successfully and Legacy Reports list returns.

manualSteps.action: Verify the Legacy Reports list retains the selected page size after the Duplicate action.
manualSteps.expected: Legacy Reports list retains the selected page size after completing the Duplicate action.
